title: A PILOT STUDY OF WEAK-TO-STRONG GENERALIZATION IN SAFETY, TOXICITY, AND LEGAL REASONING
findings: There were no findings related to religion as it was not a focus of this study. Religion was only mentioned tangentially as part of an example prompt used for generating a dataset of safe prompts.
